newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Telstra to seek partner for phone shops.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Telstra to seek partner for phone shops.

text.p: Australia government-owned Telstra Corp said on Tuesday it planned to find a retail partner to manage its national network of phone-equipment shops.
Telstra said the proposed management arrangement will be implemented nationwide over the next six to eight months.
During this time Telstra intends to finalise arrangements for the affiliated dealership, select the retail partner and continue discussions with staff and unions about the proposals.
The government plans to privatise one-third of Telstra in its first term of office, raising up to A$8 billion from the float.
The sale is subject to approval in parliament's upper house, the Senate, where the government does not have majority control.
